meta.name: ecommerce-video-marketing
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者必备！当您需要为多品类商品策划抖音、小红书等平台的带货视频时，一键生成包含痛点切入、产品展示与专业镜头设计的6阶段高质量视频脚本，轻松打造高转化营销内容，大幅提升品牌销量。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把商品卖点生成带镜头设计的带货视频脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为多品类商品快速产出高转化带货视频脚本
copy.tagline_en: Turn product selling points into video scripts with shot design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce high-converting product video scripts

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 6 阶段流程帮你写电商带货视频脚本：先问商品、人群、平台、时长，再产出痛点切入→产品展示→痛点解决的脚本，并附镜头类型、运镜与字幕/配乐建议。
howto.when: 当你需要为商品创作营销视频脚本，或想要电商视频营销的创作指导时触发；脚本时长可选 15 秒、30 秒、60 秒。

say.text: 帮我给这款自动喂食器写一个 30 秒的抖音带货脚本
say.note: 会先问人群、痛点和已有素材

say.text: 给这款护肤品写 15 秒小红书脚本，风格简约高级
say.note: 会结合品类模板套用叙事结构

say.text: 按痛点切入、产品展示、痛点解决的结构，配上镜头和运镜设计
say.note: 会给出分镜与运镜建议

howto.what_en: Claude follows a six-stage flow to write ecommerce video scripts: it asks for product, audience, platform and length, then drafts a pain-point hook, product demo and resolution, with shot types, camera moves and subtitle or music notes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a marketing video script for a product or guidance on ecommerce video marketing; length options are 15, 30 or 60 seconds.

say_en.text: Write a 30-second Douyin script for this automatic pet feeder
say_en.note: Claude first asks about audience, pain points and assets

say_en.text: Draft a 15-second Xiaohongshu script for this skincare product, minimal style
say_en.note: It applies the matching category template

say_en.text: Build it with a pain-point hook, product demo and resolution, with camera moves
say_en.note: It returns shot and camera-move suggestions
